definitions.explanation: The temporary release of an accused person awaiting trial, usually upon payment of a deposit to guarantee their appearance in court.

examples.japanese: {保釈|ほしゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{保釈|ほしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}した→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧。
⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一億円|いちおくえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保釈金|ほしゃくきん}→保釈金：24500_hoshakukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}めて→納める：02280_osameru⟧{保釈|ほしゃく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The suspect was released on bail after paying a bail deposit of 100 million yen.

notes:
A legal term for the system of releasing a defendant from custody before trial upon posting a financial guarantee. In Japan, bail is granted by the court and can be quite expensive, especially in high-profile cases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保釈|ほしゃく}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be released on bail
- {保釈|ほしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to grant bail
- {保釈|ほしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧: to apply for bail
- ⟦{保釈金|ほしゃくきん}→保釈金：24500_hoshakukin⟧: bail money / bail deposit
- {保釈|ほしゃく}⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧: bail conditions
- {保釈|ほしゃく}{取|と}り{消|け}し: revocation of bail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{釈放|しゃくほう}→釈放：14806_shakuhou⟧: release (from custody) — broader term for any release from detention, not necessarily involving bail
- ⟦{仮釈放|かりしゃくほう}→仮釈放：22608_karishakuhou⟧: parole — early release from prison after serving part of a sentence
- {勾留|こうりゅう}: detention — being held in custody before or during trial, the state that bail releases one from

REGISTER:
Formal/legal. Frequently seen in news reports about criminal cases.
